why: The results are full of major reviewers, but every page is a general portable-monitor or desktop-monitor guide. None tests or compares monitors that stack above a laptop screen. The only real link to the question is Wired's note that one Espresso stand can raise the screen to hover above a laptop, plus a single passing line from Tom's Hardware. RTINGS and TechRepublic came through with no usable text, and GearLab is an untested listicle. A focused page on stacked models, covering fit, stability and prices, would fill a clear gap. There is one risk: ChatGPT may lean on Wired's partial mention because Wired is a well-known name.
